import ast, asyncio, dataclasses, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from uuid import UUID
import numpy as np
ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
from puripuly_heart.core.audio.format import AudioCaptureSpan
from puripuly_heart.core.audio.format import float32_to_pcm16le_bytes
from puripuly_heart.core.audio.ownership import AudioSegmentIdentity, AudioSegmentSettingsSnapshot, AudioSegmentTerminalReceipt
from puripuly_heart.core.speaker.contracts import ProbabilityFrame, SourceMapPiece, SpeakerEvidence
from puripuly_heart.core.stt.backend import STTAudioClock, STTNativeProvenance, STTSourceCapabilities, STTTextTiming, STTTextContribution, STTSourceRelease, STTProviderTurnRequest, STTProviderTurnIdentity, STTProviderTurnUpdate, STTProviderTurnTerminal
from puripuly_heart.core.stt.scoped_engine import ScopedRecognitionEngine
from puripuly_heart.core.stt.streaming_speaker import StreamingSpeakerSession
from puripuly_heart.domain.recognition import NativeTranscriptionEvidence
from puripuly_heart.domain.models import FinalLanguageRun
from tests.core.test_streaming_speaker import Provider
from tests.core.test_source_context_contract import ControlledProvider, harness_for, source_fixture, finish, close

def frozen(value):
    return tuple(map(frozen, value)) if isinstance(value, list) else value

def serial(value):
    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(value):
        return {field.name: serial(getattr(value, field.name)) for field in dataclasses.fields(value)}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): serial(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return list(map(serial, value))
    return str(value) if isinstance(value, UUID) else value

def identity(raw):
    seg = dict(raw["segment"])
    seg["segment_id"] = UUID(seg["segment_id"])
    return STTProviderTurnIdentity(AudioSegmentIdentity(**seg), raw["provider_epoch_id"], raw["provider_turn_id"], frozen(raw["settings_scope"]))

def provenance(raw):
    result = dict(raw)
    native = result.get("transcription")
    if native is not None:
        assert not native["timed_words"] and not native["audio_coverage"]
        result["transcription"] = NativeTranscriptionEvidence(**{key: frozen(value) for key, value in native.items()})
    if result.get("capabilities") is not None:
        result["capabilities"] = STTSourceCapabilities(**result["capabilities"])
    result["text_timing"] = tuple(STTTextTiming(**item) for item in result["text_timing"])
    result["audio_clocks"] = tuple(STTAudioClock(**item) for item in result["audio_clocks"])
    for key in ("native_audio_progress", "native_model_metadata"):
        result[key] = frozen(result[key])
    return STTNativeProvenance(**result)

def native_event(raw):
    result = dict(raw)
    result["identity"] = identity(result["identity"])
    update = "sequence" in result
    result["provenance"] = provenance(result["provenance"]) if update else tuple(provenance(item) for item in result["provenance"])
    result["final_language_runs"] = tuple(FinalLanguageRun(**item) for item in result["final_language_runs"])
    for key in ("final_speaker_runs", "recognition_origins", "source_audio"):
        assert not result.get(key)
        if key in result:
            result[key] = ()
    if result.get("contribution") is not None:
        result["contribution"] = STTTextContribution(**result["contribution"])
    if result.get("source_release") is not None:
        result["source_release"] = STTSourceRelease(**result["source_release"])
    result["included_contributions"] = tuple(STTTextContribution(**item) for item in result["included_contributions"])
    assert result.get("failure_diagnostics") is None
    return (STTProviderTurnUpdate if update else STTProviderTurnTerminal)(**result)

def evidence(raw):
    result = dict(raw)
    result["source_map"] = tuple(SourceMapPiece(**{**piece, "capture": (AudioCaptureSpan(**piece["capture"]) if piece["capture"] is not None else None)}) for piece in result["source_map"])
    if result["frame"] is not None:
        result["frame"] = ProbabilityFrame(**{key: frozen(value) for key, value in result["frame"].items()})
    return SpeakerEvidence(**result)

def ranges(spans):
    return [[s.capture_epoch, s.normalized_start_sample, s.normalized_end_sample] for s in spans]

for path, names in (("native/nemotron/probe.py", {"audio"}), ("native/nemotron/issue215_smoke.py", {"digest", "input_cases"})):
    tree = ast.parse(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    body = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in names]
    assert len(body) == len(names)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=body, type_ignores=[]), path, "exec"), globals())
args = SimpleNamespace(corpus=Path.home()/".cache/puripuly-heart/sim-v02-public-corpus-600-v1", correction_root=ROOT.parent/"listen-mega-integrate-nemotron-speaker-tracking/docs/experiments/issue-212-clarification")
inputs, assembled = input_cases(args)
tape = json.loads(Path("build/issue264-validation-repaired-tapes-01/trace.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

async def replay(case):
    values = assembled[case["case"]][0]
    assert hashlib.sha256(values.astype("<f4").tobytes()).hexdigest() == case["input_pcm_f32_sha256"]
    pcm = float32_to_pcm16le_bytes(values)
    provider, translator = Provider(), ControlledProvider()
    harness, output = harness_for(translator)
    view = harness.peer_owner._speaker_identities.evidence
    engine = ScopedRecognitionEngine(None, evidence_view=view)
    session = StreamingSpeakerSession(provider, evidence_view=view)
    clock = harness.peer_owner.clock
    snapshots, requests, payload_bytes = {}, {}, {}
    payloads = iter(payload for event in case["trace"] if event["event"] == "native_submit" for payload in event["payloads"])
    delivered = 0
    all_evidence = tuple(map(evidence, case["evidence"]))
    produced, diagnostics, submits, terminal_text = [], [], [], []
    active = None
    writes = 0
    peak_proofs = 0

    def proof_snapshot(token):
        claim = view._proofs.get(token)
        return None if claim is None else {"primary":ranges(claim.ranges),"proven_replay":ranges(claim.replayed),"stage":claim.stage,"available":serial(view.resolve(token))}

    async def drain():
        nonlocal peak_proofs
        for _ in range(10):
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
        while session._events.depth:
            event = await session._events.get()
            if not isinstance(event, (STTProviderTurnUpdate, STTProviderTurnTerminal)):
                continue
            if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate) and event.source_release is None:
                continue
            engine._publish_speaker_proofs(event)
            produced.append({"kind":type(event).__name__, "text":event.text, "runs":serial(event.final_speaker_runs), "audio":[{"contribution":a.contribution_id,"source":ranges(a.source_ranges),"context":ranges(a.context_ranges),"proof":a.speaker_proof_id,"state":serial(a.speaker_attribution),"claim":proof_snapshot(a.speaker_proof_id),"parts":[{"text_start":p.text_start,"text_end":p.text_end,"source":ranges(p.source_ranges),"context":ranges(p.context_ranges),"historical":serial(p.speaker_attribution),"proof":p.speaker_proof_id,"claim":proof_snapshot(p.speaker_proof_id)} for p in a.speaker_parts]} for a in event.source_audio], "processed":view.processed,"immutable":view.immutable})
            snapshot = snapshots[event.identity]
            if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate):
                await harness.peer_owner.handle_provider_turn_update(snapshot, event)
            else:
                receipt = AudioSegmentTerminalReceipt(event.identity.segment, "final" if event.outcome == "final" else event.outcome, snapshot, clock.now())
                await harness.peer_owner.handle_provider_turn_terminal(receipt, event)
            await finish(harness)
            peak_proofs = max(peak_proofs, len(view._proofs))

    try:
        for row in case["trace"]:
            target = 10 + row["at"] - case["playback_started_at"]
            clock.advance(max(0, target - clock.now()))
            kind = row["event"]
            if kind == "native_begin":
                raw = row["request"]
                ident = identity(raw["identity"])
                settings = AudioSegmentSettingsSnapshot(**{key:frozen(value) for key,value in raw["settings"].items()})
                request = STTProviderTurnRequest(ident, settings, channel=raw["channel"], display_group_id=UUID(raw["display_group_id"]))
                base, _ = source_fixture(ident.segment.segment_order)
                snapshots[ident] = replace(base, identity=ident.segment, settings=settings, content_ranges=(), context_ranges=(), content_sample_count=0, context_sample_count=0, display_group_id=request.display_group_id)
                requests[ident] = request
                payload_bytes[ident] = []
                active = ident
                await session.begin_turn(request)
            elif kind == "recorded_transport_write":
                payload = next(payloads)
                spans = tuple(AudioCaptureSpan(**item) for item in payload["source_ranges"])
                data = b"".join(pcm[s.normalized_start_sample*2:s.normalized_end_sample*2] for s in spans)
                sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
                assert sha == row["pcm16_sha256"] == payload["pcm16_sha256"]
                assert len(data)//2 == row["samples"] == payload["samples"]
                await session.send_turn_audio(active, data, payload_sequence=payload["payload_sequence"], source_ranges=spans, context_only=payload["context_only"])
                payload_bytes[active].append(data)
                snapshot = snapshots[active]
                key = "context_ranges" if payload["context_only"] else "content_ranges"
                count = "context_sample_count" if payload["context_only"] else "content_sample_count"
                snapshots[active] = replace(snapshot, **{key:getattr(snapshot,key)+spans, count:getattr(snapshot,count)+len(data)//2})
                writes += 1
            elif kind == "evidence_poll":
                count = row["count"]
                batch = all_evidence[delivered:delivered+count]
                assert len(batch) == count
                delivered += count
                view.observe(batch)
                await session.observe_speaker_evidence(batch)
            elif kind == "native_result":
                event = native_event(row["value"])
                turn = session._turns.get(event.identity)
                provider.events.put(event)
                for _ in range(10):
                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
                if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnTerminal) and event.outcome == "final":
                    terminal_text.append(event.text)
                if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate) and turn is not None:
                    for timing in event.provenance.text_timing:
                        if timing.semantics == "word_interval":
                            state = session._speaker(turn, timing)
                            diagnostics.append({"text_range":[timing.text_start,timing.text_end], "raw":[timing.raw_start,timing.raw_end], "mapped":ranges(session._mapped(turn,timing)),"state":state.attribution_state,"slot":state.speaker_id,"at":row["at"]})
            elif kind == "native_submit":
                ident = identity(row["identity"])
                assert hashlib.sha256(b"".join(payload_bytes[ident])).hexdigest() == row["pcm16_sha256"]
                snapshots[ident] = replace(snapshots[ident], state="sealed", sealed_at_monotonic_s=clock.now(), seal_reason="silence")
                await session.seal_turn(ident, sealed_content_ranges=snapshots[ident].content_ranges, seal_reason="silence", observed_trailing_silence_ms=600)
                submits.append({"sha256":row["pcm16_sha256"],"samples":sum(len(p)//2 for p in payload_bytes[ident]),"context_samples":snapshots[ident].context_sample_count,"source_samples":snapshots[ident].content_sample_count})
            await drain()
        await drain()
        assert delivered == len(all_evidence)
        assert next(payloads, None) is None
        children = [item.source_child for item in output.items]
        assert "".join(source.raw_text for source in children) == "".join(terminal_text)
        child_rows = [{"text":source.raw_text,"speaker":serial(source.speaker),"origins":[{"range":list(origin.contribution_range),"source":ranges(origin.source_ranges),"context":ranges(origin.context_ranges),"proof":origin.speaker_proof_id,"historical":serial(origin.speaker_attribution),"available":serial(view.resolve(origin.speaker_proof_id))} for origin in source.origins]} for source in children]
        result = {"case":case["case"],"profile":case["profile"],"input_f32_sha256":case["input_pcm_f32_sha256"],"native_begins":len(requests),"transport_writes":writes,"submits":submits,"evidence_items":delivered,"source_children":child_rows,"translations":len(translator.calls),"context_entries":len(harness.peer_runtime.translation_history),"word_diagnostics":diagnostics,"produced":produced,"retained_proofs_before_close":len(view._proofs),"peak_admitted_proofs":peak_proofs,"processed":view.processed,"immutable":view.immutable}
        await session.close()
        result["retained_proofs_after_producer_close"] = len(view._proofs)
        for child in children:
            harness.peer_owner._speaker_identities.retire_source(child.source_id)
        result["retained_proofs_after_retirement"] = len(view._proofs)
        assert not view._proofs
        assert len(translator.calls) == len(children) == len(harness.peer_runtime.translation_history)
        return result
    finally:
        await session.close()
        await engine.close()
        await close(harness)

async def main():
    return [await replay(case) for case in tape["cases"]]
print(json.dumps(asyncio.run(main()), default=str))
